title: How to Properly Dispose of Diapers
steps: Collect used disposable diapers and place them in sealed plastic bags to prevent odors and leaks.
Do not attempt to wash and reuse single-use diapers.
Dispose of sealed diaper bags in regular household waste bins.
Do not throw diapers in recycling bins, as they are not recyclable.
Consider using compostable diapers if available and permitted by local guidelines.
Educate family members about proper diaper disposal methods to avoid environmental harm.
precautions: Avoid flushing diapers down the toilet to prevent pipe blockages.
Store used diapers in a sealed container until disposal.
Do not compost disposable diapers unless certified compostable.
Keep diapers out of reach of children and pets.
Use designated waste bins to prevent contamination.
